title: Not quite like the picture.... Color is spray painted on sadly, not iridescent at all.
text:
Not quite like the picture.... Color is spray painted on sadly, not iridescent at all.. This looks like an iridescent glass in the photo but in person it seems like there's a light pink glass used on the bottom and then on top they spray paint color from the inside. They did a decent job at it, it honestly took me a second to realize it but I can see the spray paint film inside faintly and can tell it's been painted. My big concern there would be if you use this for a floral vase, it'd probably soak the paint off fairly quickly. So I'd use this for fake flowers.

Other than that, it is pretty and the price isn't bad at all. It's a very heavyweight glass.
